Hangul letters are very easy.
Can you write your name in Hangul?
My phone has a Hangul keyboard.

examples.en: I can understand this sentence.

examples.ko: 선생님 말씀을 다 이해할 수 있어요.
examples.en: I can understand everything the teacher says.

examples.ko: 이 설명을 이해해요? — 아니요, 잘 몰라요.
examples.en: Do you understand this explanation? — No, I don't really know.
I understand my friend's feelings.
I want to understand Korean news.

explain: 이해하다는 말뿐 아니라 마음에도 써요. “이해해요”는 “I get it”이나 “I understand how you feel”이 돼요.

dict_examples.ko: 독자들은 글의 내용을 이해하고 필자의 주장을 정확하게 파악해야 한다.
dict_examples.en: Readers must understand the content of a text and accurately grasp the writer's argument.

explain_en: 이해하다 is for words and also for feelings. 이해해요 can mean “I get it” or “I understand how you feel”.

dis.h: understand; general, comprehend meaning or feelings

p.n: 알아듣다 is only for catching spoken words, so it is not used for feelings.

examples.en: I can explain this word.
Please explain how to use it again.

examples.ko: 이 단어를 쉬운 말로 설명해 주세요.
examples.en: Please explain this word in easy words.
The book explains the grammar.

examples.ko: 길을 설명할 수 있어요? 지도가 없어요.
examples.en: Can you explain the way? I don't have a map.

explain: 설명은 명사로도 써요. “설명을 듣다”, “설명을 읽다”라고 해요. “설명서”는 사용 방법이 적힌 종이예요.

explain_en: 설명 is also a noun: 설명을 듣다 (listen to an explanation), 설명을 읽다. A 설명서 is a manual.

examples.en: My older sister sings really well.
Did you sleep well last night?
Are you good at swimming? — Yes, I swim every week.
You can hear the music well here.
Good luck on your exam! — Thank you.

explain_en: 잘 comes before a verb and tells how you do it: 잘 자요, 잘 먹어요. 좋아요 describes a state.

p.n: 익히 is literary and suggests long familiarity; 잘 is everyday.

examples.en: My younger sibling dances in their room every day.
The music's on. Everyone, let's dance!
I dance with my friend at the party.

examples.ko: 저는 춤출 수 있어요. 케이팝을 좋아해요.
examples.en: I can dance. I like K-pop.
People danced at the wedding.

explain: “춤추다”와 “춤을 추다”는 같은 말이에요. “춤을 해요”라고는 안 해요.

examples.en: I can introduce myself.
I introduced myself in Korean at the first class.
I have to introduce myself at the interview.
Please introduce yourself.

examples.en: Keep your self-introduction short. Say your name and job.

explain: 자기소개는 말이에요. 글로 쓰면 “자기소개서”라고 해요. 회사나 학교에 낼 때 써요.

dict_examples.ko: 전학 온 학생은 자기소개를 하고 자리에 가서 앉았다.
